name: Dove Australia
summary: Adelaide ISP/web host trading as Multi Transmission Xchange (MTX), Innovative Network of South Australia and — from Sep 2000 — as Asia Online's SA arm; deed of company arrangement Apr 2002, wound up with ABN cancelled 19 Oct 2004 (DOVE AUSTRALIA PTY LTD, ACN 007 800 142).

events.details: Adelaide (SA) ISP/web host, DOVE AUSTRALIA PTY LTD (ACN 007 800 142). Earliest Wayback capture of dove.net.au 25 Dec 1996; the 2000 homepage carries the title 'DOVE Australia Pty. Ltd. ~ A.C.N. 007 800 142'.

Registered business names Multi Transmission Xchange and Innovative Network of South Australia from 1 May 2000, then Asia Online from 7 Sep 2000 (per ABR) - i.e. it operated as the South Australian arm of Asia Online; mtx.net.au served the Asia Online website by Apr 2001.
Entered a deed of company arrangement 6 Apr 2002 (S B Kershaw, deed administrator); ABN 35 007 800 142 cancelled 19 Oct 2004 (per ABR).
